mapf_prioritized — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mapf_prioritized(grid, starts, goals, order=None, horizon=None) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.mapf_prioritized(grid, starts, goals, order=None, horizon=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("mapf_prioritized"))

Usage

Prioritized planning: plans 1 vehicle at a time in order, avoiding the paths of vehicles already decided (reservation table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

速いが不完全 —— 解がある問題でも、優先順によっては(どの順でも)見つけられない(Ma ら 2019)。返りは dict: paths(失敗なら None)、cost、solved、failed_agent(最初に詰まった車両)。
